params.body:
Adds `docs/owner-workflow-audit/README.md`, a critical read of the owner-facing side of the workbench, written from the code of portal, control, portal-cli, elixir and portal-android as of 9 October 2026.

What it finds:
- No single place lists what waits for the owner; pull requests are not in Portal at all.
- The gateway's review request is best effort, configured in two places, and its failure is recorded but never shown.
- Admitting a project while the gateway is down makes the knock disappear although nothing can happen; an agent that is gone loses its admission silently.
- The tunnel restarts but cannot repair a corrupt gcloud settings database (4 and 9 October, written up in the incident document merged as #145); reads on the workbench fail with misleading errors when the gateway is down.

It recommends a computed *Waiting for you* list in Portal built on `OwnerState`, a four-state vocabulary, a prioritised list of ten fixes and a rollout of one small pull request per step. Documentation only: nothing here changes behaviour.

Tests: `npm test` (astro build and node tests) passes.
params.title: Audit what waits for the owner and why it stays waiting
